title: 触发提示条 · 深色卡片文字可读性

assertions.message: 提示条标题与卡片实际底色的对比度不低于 4.5:1
assertions.expression: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('[data-turn-trigger]'); const header = root && root.querySelector('button'); if (!root || !header) return false; const rgba = (value) => { const n = value.match(/[\d.]+/g); return [Number(n[0]), Number(n[1]), Number(n[2]), n.length > 3 ? Number(n[3]) : 1]; }; const over = (top, bottom) => top.slice(0, 3).map((v, i) => Math.round(v * top[3] + bottom[i] * (1 - top[3]))); const lum = (rgb) => { const f = (v) => { v /= 255; return v <= 0.03928 ? v / 12.92 : Math.pow((v + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); }; return 0.2126 * f(rgb[0]) + 0.7152 * f(rgb[1]) + 0.0722 * f(rgb[2]); }; const page = rgba(getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor); const card = over(rgba(getComputedStyle(root).backgroundColor), page); const fg = rgba(getComputedStyle(header).color); const [light, dark] = [lum(fg), lum(card)].sort((a, b) => b - a); return (light + 0.05) / (dark + 0.05) >= 4.5; })()

assertions.message: 亮色修正只落在亮色分支，深色模式沿用夜间文字色
assertions.expression: (() => { const header = document.querySelector('[data-turn-trigger] button'); if (!header) return false; const dark = document.body.hasAttribute('data-ds-dark-theme'); const color = getComputedStyle(header).color; return dark ? color === 'rgb(203, 185, 148)' : color === 'rgb(166, 149, 128)'; })()
